stepNotes.1: Scoped the unit to the single namespace at shell.ts:15; five exports, 17 in-repo call sites across pty/tool/session/provider/lsp/mcp/cli. Leaf utility, no transitive subsystem coupling.
stepNotes.2: Risk surface is process lifecycle. Traced killTree (shell.ts:16-55) failure paths: ESRCH handled by catch at :42, EPERM (non-group-leader) by inner fallback at :46, win32 taskkill /f /t at :26 resolves on exit+error so it cannot hang.
stepNotes.3: Verified the detached-spawn contract that justifies process.kill(-pid) at shell.ts:37 is honored at bash-impl.ts:756,776 and prompt-shell-command.ts:84; setsid variant at bash-impl.ts:760 also yields a fresh group. Only mcp/impl.ts:64-76 supplies a positive-pid kill closure that breaks group semantics on the fallback branch.
stepNotes.4: No hot paths; killTree worst case ~400-600ms via the two 200ms SIGKILL_TIMEOUT_MS sleeps. _preferred/_acceptable memoized via lazy() so env lookups happen once; noted lazy.reset() is never called so tests can't invalidate.
stepNotes.5: Cohesion is tight (pick a shell / stop a tree). KillableProcess structural type at shell.ts:10-13 is minimal and fits both ChildProcess and the MCP shim. preferred vs acceptable blacklist asymmetry is deliberate (interactive PTY vs scripted bash tool) but undocumented at the call sites.
stepNotes.6: No dead exports; both silent catches at shell.ts:42 and :51 carry explanatory comments and are intentional control flow. Only fragile literal is the git-bash relative path at :74, mitigated by the COMSPEC/cmd.exe final fallback at :77 and the AX_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH override flag at :69.
stepNotes.7: Direct unit test test/shell/shell.test.ts:5-17 covers isAcceptable + case-insensitive win32 extension stripping. killTree, the win32 taskkill branch, the EPERM/ESRCH fallback, and lazy reset have no dedicated coverage; indirectly exercised via prompt-shell-command.test.ts and shell-env.test.ts.
stepNotes.8: No Critical/High. MEDIUM: killTree EPERM fallback degrades to direct-only kill (mcp/impl.ts closure is the one at-risk caller). LOW: Windows git-bash layout heuristic (shell.ts:70-77). LOW: lazy caches have no reset seam. INFO: preferred/acceptable asymmetry undocumented.
stepNotes.9: Ledger consistent with empty findings/ dir and MODULE-AUDIT.md '_none accepted_' row. No Critical items => reverify.md not required by the dual-agent gate. Handed to verifier codex-sol for confirmation.
